name: @la/lang-conformance
description: The language-pack TCK (ADR §4.1): describeLanguagePack — the parameterized Vitest conformance suite any pack instantiates in ~10 lines — running the six ADR §4.2 law categories as fast-check properties, plus the golden-fixture harness and the probeSidecar black-box HTTP helper. Runtime-depends ONLY on @la/contract (never engine, never a lang-* pack — ADR §4.1, enforced by dependency-cruiser); vitest and fast-check are dev-time surfaces of the consuming pack's own test run.
